Product.RichDescription:
Breville The Custom Loaf Pro Bread Maker
The Custom Loaf knows the baking time when you make a selection. Choose your setting, set a custom time you'd like your bread to be ready and it will tell you when to add in fruit or nuts at the perfect time and also lets you create your own masterpiece.

Key Features

  • Manual & automatic programs
  • Collapsible kneading blade
  • Automatic fruit and nut dispenser
  • Smart LCD display
  • Power interruption protection
  • AU/NZ Plug - 830W 220-240W


Dimensions Approx.
41.2 x 18.2 x 27.3 cm - Appliance Size

Includes
1 x Bread Maker
1 x Collapsible paddle
1 x Ficed Paddle
